documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching INR 1,555 crores and EBITDA standing at INR 548 crores at a 35% margin. The company achieved record quarterly solar module and cell production, alongside an order book of 9.9 gigawatts supported by fresh inflows. Management highlighted ongoing progress on its 6-gigawatt integrated TOPCon cell and module expansion, as well as a medium-term backward integration plan into ingot and wafer manufacturing. Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited reported a strong Q1 FY2027 performance with revenue of INR 15,555 million, representing a 51% year-on-year increase. The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 35% and a PAT margin of 24%, supported by operational leverage and increased internal cell consumption.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of EBITDA by the close of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of an EBITDA by the close of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that the order book provides healthy revenue visibility and reflects continued demand across utility-scale, commercial and industrial, and rooftop solar segments.
demand_outlook.quote: The order book provides healthy revenue visibility and reflects continued demand across utility-scale, commercial and industrial, and rooftop solar segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells continues to remain relatively tight.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic supply of high-efficiency TOPCon cells continues to remain relatively tight, which should support the operating environment for established and compliant cell manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that the DCR demand is expected to expand beyond government schemes following the implementation of ALMM List 2.
demand_outlook.quote: The requirement for the use of domestically manufactured cells in covered projects is expected to expand the addressable DCR market beyond the government schemes.

capex_expansion.claim: The module line of the 6-gigawatt integrated facility is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the 6-gigawatt expansion is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost is estimated at approximately INR 5,500 crores, including hard costs of around INR 4,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at the cost of less than 8% for the expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Debt funding of approximately INR 3,300 crores has been tied up at the cost of less than 8%.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed backward integration into ingot and wafer manufacturing will have a total of 9 gigawatt planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and 4 gigawatt in FY2030.
capex_expansion.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.

capex_expansion.claim: Following the completion of the 6-gigawatt expansion, total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Following the completion of this expansion, our total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for the quarter improved to 35% compared to 34% in Q1FY26 and 33% in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: An EBITDA margin improved to 35% compared to 34% in Q1FY26 and 33% in Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax margin improved to 24% compared to 18% in the corresponding quarter last year and 23% in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 24% compared to 18% in the corresponding quarter last year and 23% in the previous quarter, due to lower finance costs that reduced significantly to INR 11.1 crores compared to INR 53.1 crores in Q1FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management states that the EBITDA spread is guided at around INR 2.5 per watt for modules and INR 6.00-6.5 per watt for cells.
margins_costs.quote: And EBITDA per watt, I think what we had guided is around INR 2.5 per watt for just module, and for the cell it is of INR 6.00-6.5 per watt.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book further strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt at the end of the quarter, supported by fresh order inflows of approximately 1.5 gigawatt.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book further strengthened to 9.9 gigawatt, supported by fresh order inflows and approximately 1.5 gigawatt.

orders_capacity.claim: Current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current installed capacity stands at 10.3 gigawatt of solar modules and 2.94 gigawatt of TOPCon cells.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital expenditure for the ingot and wafer backward integration facility is expected to be funded largely through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The capital expenditure for the same is expected to be funded largely through internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management notes geopolitical issues as a strategic reason for keeping slightly more raw material inventory.
risks_headwinds.quote: And added to that, this quarter we have strategically kept little more raw material inventory. Reason being the geopolitical issues what is taking place.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified risks including fluctuations in earnings, market growth, intense competition, and changes in regulatory environments.
risks_headwinds.quote: These forward-looking statements are based on certain expectations, assumptions, anticipated developments and other factors which are not limited to, risk and uncertainties regarding fluctuations in earnings, market growth, intense competition and the pricing environment in the market, consumption level, ability to maintain and manage key customer relationship and supply chain sources and those factors which may affect our ability to implement business strategies successfully, namely changes in regulatory environments, political instability, change in international oil prices and input costs and new or changed priorities of the trade.

management_commitments.claim: The module line of the 6-gigawatt facility is expected to be commissioned by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The module line is expected to be commissioned by December 2026, followed by the cell line by March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.
management_commitments.quote: Following the completion of this expansion, our total manufacturing capacity is expected to increase to approximately 16.3 gigawatt of modules and 8.9 gigawatt of cells by end of FY2027.

management_commitments.claim: The proposed ingot and wafer facility is planned in two phases, targeting 5 gigawatt in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.
management_commitments.quote: The proposed facility will have a total of 9 gigawatt and is planned in two phases, with 5 gigawatt targeted in FY2029 and the remaining 4 gigawatt in FY2030.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of an EBITDA by the close of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting approximately INR 2,400 crore of an EBITDA by the close of FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
